content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To learn to shoot, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Study the ballistics of various calibers (4 hours)
Step 2. Register for a competitive shooting league (1 hour)
Step 3. Practice proper trigger reset drills (2 hours)
Step 4. Clean and lubricate the firearm after use (45 minutes)
Step 5. Purchase a high-quality holster (30 minutes)
Step 6. Research local gun ranges (1 hour)
Step 7. Practice drawing from a holster (2 hours)
Step 8. Watch instructional videos on grip (2 hours)
Step 9. Participate in a long-range shooting workshop (1 day)
Step 10. Purchase a dedicated range bag (30 minutes)
Step 11. Practice dry-firing at home (30 minutes)
Step 12. Learn to align iron sights (1 hour)
Step 13. Purchase bulk ammunition (20 minutes)
Step 14. Organize ammunition by grain weight (30 minutes)
Step 15. Enroll in a basic firearm safety course (8 hours)
Step 16. Visit the chosen range for a tour (30 minutes)
Step 17. Apply for a firearm purchase permit (2 weeks)
Step 18. Practice controlled breathing techniques (1 hour)
Step 19. Buy a beginner-friendly handgun (1 hour)
Step 20. Shoot a qualifying round for certification (2 hours)
Step 21. Research optical sights versus iron sights (3 hours)
Step 22. Attend a range safety officer briefing (1 hour)
Step 23. Adjust holster retention screws (10 minutes)
Step 24. Practice the four rules of gun safety (1 hour)
Step 25. Install a red dot sight (30 minutes)
Step 26. Learn to clear a double-feed malfunction (1 hour)
Step 27. Purchase ear and eye protection (45 minutes)
Step 28. Set a training budget (1 hour)
Step 29. Practice administrative loading and unloading (30 minutes)
Step 30. Read the firearm manufacturer manual (2 hours)
Step 31. Practice shooting from a kneeling position (1 hour)
Step 32. Purchase a cleaning kit and solvent (20 minutes)
Step 33. Practice target acquisition transitions (2 hours)
Step 34. Learn to clear a stovepipe malfunction (30 minutes)
Step 35. Lubricate the slide rails (5 minutes)

Step 39. Load magazines to full capacity (15 minutes)
Step 40. Read reviews on different firearm brands (3 hours)

Step 42. Study the mechanics of a trigger pull (2 hours)
Step 43. Purchase snap caps for training (15 minutes)
Step 44. Identify a reputable firearms instructor (2 hours)
Step 45. Practice shooting with the non-dominant hand (1 hour)
Step 46. Execute a live-fire grouping test (1 hour)
Step 47. Learn to find a natural point of aim (1 hour)
Step 48. Subscribe to a shooting sports magazine (15 minutes)
Step 49. Buy a digital shot timer (10 minutes)
Step 50. Practice drawing from a concealed position (2 hours)
Step 51. Visit several gun stores to compare prices (4 hours)
Step 52. Take a class on defensive shooting fundamentals (6 hours)
Step 53. Practice low-light shooting with a flashlight (2 hours)
Step 54. Buy a heavy-duty gun belt (20 minutes)
Step 55. Research firearm maintenance schedules (1 hour)
Step 56. Compare different types of gun safes (2 hours)
Step 57. Practice strong-hand-only shooting (1 hour)
Step 58. Zero the sights at 15 yards (45 minutes)
Step 59. Practice shooting while moving (2 hours)
Step 60. Attend a concealed carry permit class (1 day)
Step 61. Practice rapid-fire strings (30 minutes)
Step 62. Buy a specialized shooting vest (45 minutes)
Step 63. Study different shooting stances like Weaver or Isosceles (2 hours)
Step 64. Purchase a hard-shell carrying case (30 minutes)
Step 65. Practice recoil management (1 hour)
Step 66. Learn to disassemble the firearm for cleaning (30 minutes)
Step 67. Analyze shot placement on a paper target (30 minutes)
Step 68. Read about the legalities of self-defense (5 hours)
Step 69. Practice mental visualization of the perfect shot (30 minutes)
Step 70. Order specialized targets online (15 minutes)
